title: Score d'Aldrete
formula:
The Modified Aldrete Score (MAS) is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Clinical Assessment | Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Activity | Able to move 0 extremities voluntarily or on command | 0 |
| Able to move 2 extremities voluntarily or on command | 1 | |
| Able to move 4 extremities voluntarily or on command | 2 | |
| Respiratory | Apneic | 0 |
| Dyspnea or limited breathing | 1 | |
| Able to breathe deeply and cough freely | 2 | |
| Circulation | Blood pressure ± 50% of preanesthetic level | 0 |
| Blood pressure ± 20%-49% of preanesthetic level | 1 | |
| Blood pressure ± 20% of preanesthetic level | 2 | |
| Consciousness | Not responding | 0 |
| Arousable on calling | 1 | |
| Fully awake | 2 | |
| O₂ saturation | O₂ saturation <90% even with O₂ supplement | 0 |
| Needs O₂ inhalation to maintain O₂ saturation >90% | 1 | |
| Able to maintain O₂ saturation >92% on room air | 2 | |

The Expanded Postanesthetic Recovery Score for Patients Having Anesthesia on Ambulatory Basis (PARSAP) is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Clinical Assessment | Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Activity | Unable to move extremities voluntarily or on command | 0 |
| Able to move two extremities voluntarily or on command | 1 | |
| Able to move four extremities voluntarily or on command | 2 | |
| Respiratory | Apneic | 0 |
| Dyspnea or limited breathing | 1 | |
| Able to breathe deeply and cough freely | 2 | |
| Circulation | Blood pressure ± 50% of preanesthetic level | 0 |
| Blood pressure ± 20%-49% of preanesthetic level | 1 | |
| Blood pressure ± 20% of preanesthetic level | 2 | |
| Consciousness | Not responding | 0 |
| Arousable on calling | 1 | |
| Fully awake | 2 | |
| O₂ saturation | O₂ saturation <90% even with O₂ supplement | 0 |
| Needs O₂ inhalation to maintain O₂ saturation >90% | 1 | |
| Able to maintain O₂ saturation >92% on room air | 2 | |
| Dressing | Growing area of wetness | 0 |
| Wet but marked and not increasing | 1 | |
| Dry and clean | 2 | |
| Pain | Severe pain requiring parenteral medication | 0 |
| Mild pain handled by oral medication | 1 | |
| Pain free | 2 | |
| Ambulation | Dizziness when supine | 0 |
| Vertigo when erect | 1 | |
| Able to stand up and walk straight* | 2 | |
| Fasting-feeding | Nausea and vomiting | 0 |
| Nauseated | 1 | |
| Able to drink fluids | 2 | |
| Urine output | Unable to void and uncomfortable | 0 |
| Unable to void but comfortable | 1 | |
| Has voided | 2 | |

*May be substituted by Romberg test or picking up 12 clips in one hand.

how_to_use.why:
- Largement adopté pour standardiser le transfert depuis la récupération en Phase I et soutenir une progression sûre des soins.
- Aide à signaler une récupération incomplète, ce qui réduit les sorties prématurées/événements indésirables lorsqu'il est utilisé avec le jugement clinique.
- S'aligne sur les attentes de la Joint Commission d'utiliser des critères objectifs, approuvés par le personnel médical, pour la sortie de la PACU.
how_to_use.when:
- À utiliser lors de la phase I de récupération pour déterminer l’aptitude au passage en phase II ou vers une unité d’hospitalisation.
- Des variables supplémentaires peuvent être utilisées en chirurgie ambulatoire pour déterminer l’aptitude à la sortie à domicile.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Also known as the Postanesthesia Recovery Score (PARS); originally modeled after the Apgar concept to document emergence from anesthesia.
- The original “color” item was replaced by pulse oximetry in the 1995 modified version (MAS) to improve objectivity.
- The 1998 ambulatory version (PARSAP) adds five items to better assess home readiness.
- Developed for adults but validated and widely used in children.
- The 5-item inpatient tool omits issues that may still warrant observation or escalation, such as:

 - Cardiac dysrhythmias not affecting blood pressure.
 - Bleeding at the incision site.
 - Severe, uncontrolled pain.
 - Persistent nausea and vomiting.

next_steps.advice: La douleur, les nausées/vomissements, la température, les saignements et les problèmes du site opératoire ne sont pas directement évalués par le score à 5 items ; évaluez-les séparément et renforcez la surveillance ou le niveau de soins selon les indications.
next_steps.management:
Thresholds may vary by institution; refer to your local protocols.

**Inpatient surgery:**

- **Score ≥9 and clinically stable:** Transition to Phase II or an inpatient unit per facility protocol.
- **Score <9 (or any category with a score of 0):**

 - Identify the cause (e.g., hypoxia, hypotension, somnolence, inadequate motor function).
 - Intervene: airway support, titrate O₂, treat hypoventilation (stimulate, reverse agents if indicated), fluid/vasoactive therapy for hypotension, manage pain/antiemetics.
 - Continue PACU-level monitoring and reassess at intervals until criteria met; escalate to anesthesia if deficits persist.

**Ambulatory/same-day surgery:**

- If the patient **does not meet fast-tracking criteria** (per local protocol):

 - Proceed with Phase I recovery in PACU.
 - Transition to Phase II when **MAS ≥9 and clinically stable** (similar to above guidance for inpatient surgery).
- **Once PARSAP ≥18 in Phase II:**

 - Appropriate for discharge home.
 - Ensure pain control, minimal nausea and vomiting, and safe ambulation.
 - A responsible escort should be available.
 - Provide clear postoperative instructions.

more_info:
Interprétation :

| Modified Aldrete Score (MAS) | Aptitude à la phase II ou à une prise en charge en hospitalisation |
| --- | --- |
| <9 | Non apte au passage en phase II ou en hospitalisation |
| ≥9 | Apte au passage en phase II ou en hospitalisation |

| PARSAP | Aptitude à la sortie (chirurgie ambulatoire uniquement) |
| --- | --- |
| <18 | Non apte au retour à domicile |
| ≥18 | Peut être apte au retour à domicile |
